title: Add okuma-osp.cps 3-axis milling post with conformance goldens

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

body:
Add a clean-room 3-axis milling post for Okuma OSP controls (OSP-P200M, OSP-P300M, OSP-P500). Use only CamCraft code, public Okuma manuals, and ISO 6983 standards. Use no Autodesk or HSMWorks material.

## Requirements
- Add `assets/posts/okuma-osp.cps` following the structure of `assets/posts/mazak.cps` and `assets/posts/doosan-dnm.cps`.
- Set `vendor = "Camcraft"`, `extension = "min"`, `programUnits = "mm inch"`, `coolantModes = true`, `afterModes = true`, `axisInversion = true`, and `millSpindleReverse = true`.
- Omit `explains` (because `crates/post/src/post/explain.rs` hardcodes Fanuc `G53`/`G43`/`G49` words) and omit `probeAxisInversion`.
- Write `O0001` to `O9999` program numbers with 40-char uppercase comments, an optional `$NAME.MIN%` tape header property, and `M02`/`M30` end without `G91 G28`.
- Gate `G20`/`G21` unit confirmation behind a `writeUnitCode` property (default `true` so `crates/app/tests/post_unit_word.rs` passes).
- Map `PARAM WorkOffset` `"G54".."G59"` to `G15 H1`..`G15 H6` and refuse unknown offsets by name (`crates/app/tests/sinumerik_work_offsets.rs` pattern).
- Write `G56 H<n>` for Z tool length offset and `G53` for cancel. Never emit `G53 Z0` without `G15 H0` or `G30 P1`, and honor `machine.safeRetractZ` (`crates/app/tests/sinumerik_safe_retract.rs` pattern).
- Skip duplicate `T<n> M06` calls for consecutive ops on the same tool and offer an optional `IF [VTLCN EQ <n>]` guard property.
- Output `G71 Z<clearance>` with `M53`/`M54` for fixed cycle return levels, output seconds for `G04`/`G82`/`G89` `P` dwells, support `G81`/`G82`/`G73`/`G83`/`G85`/`G86`/`G89`, and emit `G284`/`G274` synchronized rigid tapping.
- Output `G17`/`G18`/`G19` `G02`/`G03` arcs with incremental `I`/`J`/`K` centers only.
- Read M-codes from `machine.coolants` first, with OSP defaults (`Flood` `M08`, `Mist` `M07`, `Through-spindle`/`Through-tool` `M51`, `Air` `M59`, off `M09`).
- Refuse probing operations cleanly by name in this slice.
- Register `"Okuma OSP"` in `BUILTINS` (`crates/app/src/posting.rs`), update `crates/app/tests/conformance.rs` goldens, and add `crates/app/tests/okuma_post.rs` for OSP safety checks.

Done means: `okuma-osp.cps` passes all 3-axis conformance goldens byte-exact, passes OSP offset/retract/cycle/unit/coolant/same-tool tests, and refuses probe ops cleanly.

Part of #1959
